The twelve Units of Grade 8 (G+M) across the school
year. Each Unit covers roughly three teaching weeks.

| Unit | Title | Skills focus | Exam type |
|------|-------|--------------|-----------|
| 1 | [Identities](units/unit01_identities.qmd) | reading, writing, intercultural | class test ("Klassenarbeit") |
| 2 | [School Life Elsewhere](units/unit02_school-life-elsewhere.qmd) | reading, speaking, intercultural | class test ("Klassenarbeit") |
| 3 | [Fairness at School](units/unit03_fairness-at-school.qmd) | speaking, writing, language_awareness | class test ("Klassenarbeit") |
| 4 | [Ireland: Stories from the Island](units/unit04_ireland-stories.qmd) | reading, writing, intercultural | class test ("Klassenarbeit") |
| 5 | [Digital Friendships](units/unit05_digital-friendships.qmd) | listening, writing, language_awareness | class test ("Klassenarbeit") |
| 6 | [Writing an Opinion](units/unit06_opinion-writing.qmd) | reading, writing, language_awareness | class test ("Klassenarbeit") |
| 7 | [Mediation: A Teen Magazine](units/unit07_teen-magazine-mediation.qmd) | mediation, writing, language_awareness | class test ("Klassenarbeit") |
| 8 | [Music and Belonging](units/unit08_music-and-belonging.qmd) | listening, speaking, intercultural | class test ("Klassenarbeit") |
| 9 | [Rural and Urban Lives](units/unit09_rural-and-urban.qmd) | reading, writing, intercultural | class test ("Klassenarbeit") |
| 10 | [A Novella in Class](units/unit10_a-novella-in-class.qmd) | reading, writing, language_awareness | class test ("Klassenarbeit") |
| 11 | [Public Speaking: A Short Talk](units/unit11_public-speaking.qmd) | speaking, listening, language_awareness | class test ("Klassenarbeit") |
| 12 | [Class Magazine Issue](units/unit12_school-magazine-issue.qmd) | writing, speaking, language_awareness | class test ("Klassenarbeit") |
